deploy_controller_and_manifest_repair: The deployment workflow and deploy script allow write-proof profile activation on the exact accepted and served release commit when subsequent task PRs have advanced the dev tip.
The switch-time candidate order guard extends the exact-live served candidate write-proof exception while retaining controller identity and live-target CAS checks.

The deployment workflow pins namespaced compatibility refs per run/attempt (refs/pantheon-proof/${GITHUB_RUN_ID}-${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT}/*) before generating the Agora compatibility manifest and running the Agora deployment gate.
The independent watchdog namespaces compatibility refs per run/attempt, asserting both namespaced refs resolve to the authorized CANDIDATE_SHA and BFF_SHA before Agora gate revalidation.

The watchdog restore step is marked `if: always()` and pre-restore compatibility revalidation is marked `continue-on-error: true` so pre-restore errors unconditionally fall through to exact same-pair read-only restoration.
credential_controller: Repository actions secret DEV_BFF_DEV_LOGIN_VIEWER_CLIENT_SECRET provisioned on execute-plans repository to supply required dedicated viewer client credentials alongside DEV_BFF_DEV_LOGIN_OPERATOR_A_CLIENT_SECRET.
Both operator and viewer tokens are freshly minted at runtime via /bff/auth/dev-login with strict TTL (>1200s) and max-age (<120s) preflight.
execution_architecture: The deployment workflow, restore watchdog, and integration gate authorize parent-bound hosted proof dispatches on dev branch while binding the candidate to the exact accepted and served candidate SHA via the signed parent proof binding artifact.

The restore watchdog and integration gate validate parent and child run identity, event (workflow_dispatch), dev branch, and signed proof binding artifact without requiring the dev branch tip SHA to equal the candidate SHA.
Merging this repair to dev enables the authorized parent deploy dispatch from dev to successfully arm the watchdog, activate write-proof, run the hosted proof, and restore read-only.
not_changed: Product runtime contracts, BFF API contracts, and default read-only deployment profile.
No live capital action and no outbound Source Ingestion external pulls.
Watchdog single-coordinator architecture and fail-closed restore semantics.
